tasks.title: Define the release success criteria
tasks.description: Agree the three measurable outcomes for the release and the owner of each metric. Publish the decision with an explicit launch/no-launch threshold.

tasks.title: Fix the trial conversion dashboard
tasks.description: Reconcile trial conversion counts with the signup source and remove duplicate events. Date filters must use the same account timezone and match the exported totals.

tasks.title: Review onboarding support themes
tasks.description: Group recent onboarding questions by the step where customers got stuck. Summarize the top three patterns and propose one small improvement for each.

tasks.title: Prepare the partner demo
tasks.description: Build a short demo around a realistic partner workflow. Confirm that the sample account is clean and the walkthrough fits into twenty minutes.

tasks.title: Coordinate the release readiness review
tasks.description: Check release blockers with engineering, product and support. Record a named owner and a next decision time for every unresolved item.

tasks.title: Document next week priorities
tasks.description: Collect the carry-over decisions and prepare a focused list for the next planning session. Keep committed work separate from ideas that still need research.

tasks.title: Build the account settings screen
tasks.description: Implement account name, timezone and notification settings. Invalid values must show field-level feedback and successful changes must survive reload.

tasks.title: Fix duplicate notification delivery
tasks.description: Find why one notification is delivered twice after a reconnect. Add a regression that proves one user action produces only one message.

tasks.title: Add project search shortcuts
tasks.description: Add keyboard shortcuts for opening project search and moving through results. Search must return focus to the original control when it closes.

tasks.title: Review the dashboard API contract
tasks.description: Align the dashboard response with the agreed filter and pagination contract. Document empty, loading and partial-data states for the UI.

tasks.title: Pair on the accessibility audit
tasks.description: Check focus order, readable labels and contrast in the new task controls. Turn each confirmed problem into a small reproducible issue.

tasks.title: Write the component migration guide
tasks.description: Write the migration steps for the shared form components. Include before/after examples and a rollback checklist for the remaining screens.

tasks.title: Improve the task filtering API
tasks.description: Reduce repeated queries in the task-filtering endpoint without changing result order. Verify combinations of assignee, status and archived filters.

tasks.title: Fix a daylight saving date regression
tasks.description: Reproduce the date regression around the daylight-saving transition. Preserve date-only values and test both sides of the affected boundary.

tasks.title: Add timeline dependency validation
tasks.description: Reject invalid dependency changes before updating any timeline row. Cover a cyclic edge and a missing predecessor with clear validation messages.

tasks.title: Review background job observability
tasks.description: Confirm that delayed and failed jobs have actionable status and correlation IDs. Update the runbook with one safe investigation path.

tasks.title: Investigate slow report queries
tasks.description: Measure the slowest saved-report query on a representative project. Propose an indexed plan and verify that pinned report totals stay identical.

tasks.title: Prepare the deployment checklist
tasks.description: Prepare the release checks for migrations, health responses and served assets. Make the rollback boundary explicit before the deployment review.

tasks.title: Run five customer interviews
tasks.description: Interview five participants about the first week of adoption. Capture concrete examples of missing context rather than general feature requests.

tasks.title: Refine the pricing experiment brief
tasks.description: Define the pricing hypothesis, target segment and expected outcome. Specify a stop rule before drafting any experiment communication.

tasks.title: Analyze the first-run drop-off
tasks.description: Compare the first-run funnel by entry source and device class. Identify the earliest meaningful drop-off and list the instrumentation gaps.

tasks.title: Review the product story with design
tasks.description: Review the feature narrative with design using three end-to-end scenarios. Resolve terminology mismatches before updating the prototype.

tasks.title: Plan the team discovery workshop
tasks.description: Prepare a short discovery workshop with clear questions and time boxes. Send the team a one-page brief and collect decisions afterwards.

tasks.title: Summarize the usability findings
tasks.description: Summarize the usability sessions as observable problems with evidence. Separate fixes needed for the current workflow from future opportunities.

tasks.title: Prepare the enterprise discovery calls
tasks.description: Prepare tailored discovery questions for the enterprise prospects. Focus on the current process, decision owners and buying constraints.

tasks.title: Follow up on two pilot proposals
tasks.description: Follow up on two pilot proposals with a concrete next step. Record unanswered questions and avoid promising features outside the agreed scope.

tasks.title: Review the sales qualification rubric
tasks.description: Review the qualification rubric against recent opportunities. Clarify ambiguous criteria and show one example for each decision.

tasks.title: Update the customer rollout plan
tasks.description: Update the rollout plan with training, ownership and a clear success measure. Identify the dependencies that could prevent the first team from starting.

tasks.title: Coordinate the weekly account review
tasks.description: Review account risks and open commitments with the team. Confirm the next action and owner for each active conversation.

tasks.title: Clean up the prospect handoff notes
tasks.description: Remove duplicate handoff notes and link the final brief to the right opportunity. Preserve factual context while making the next action easy to find.

lateTasks.title: Handle the unexpected security questionnaire
lateTasks.description: Answer the new security questionnaire using the approved product documentation. Escalate unsupported answers and keep this added request outside the original weekly plan.

lateTasks.title: Resolve an urgent partner escalation
lateTasks.description: Triage the urgent partner issue and agree a safe workaround. Record the actual time separately because this interruption was not part of the original plan.
